front.title: OAuth Actor Receipts for Delegation Provenance

abstract.t: This document defines OAuth Actor Receipts, an optional companion to the OAuth Actor Profile for Delegation. Each receipt is a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) attesting which issuer added an actor hop and, optionally, the hop's historical presenter binding. The actor_receipts claim carries a hash-linked chain of receipts that recipients verify against each hop's issuer. This document specifies receipt processing rules and the associated metadata parameters and introspection response members.
